user_decisions.action_set: launch app, open URI, send intent, media command - all permission-free
user_decisions.unmapped_tag: finish silently, no UI, no action
user_decisions.deferred_by_user: Do Not Disturb and Toggl HTTP, both explicit non-goals

key_constraints: an Android app cannot run code on a tag tap unless the system launches it; there is no background NFC listener
the trigger activity must be exported for NFC dispatch, so it must refuse any launch that is not a genuine NFC dispatch with an assigned UID
listing installed apps on API 30+ needs a <queries> manifest declaration, NOT the restricted QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES permission
no new runtime permission is requested by this feature
reader mode wins while NFC Explorer is foregrounded, so actions fire when the app is closed - the normal case

phases.title: Action model and Intent mapping
phases.outcome: action types described in pure Kotlin, mapping proven without Android

phases.title: Persistence
phases.outcome: assignments survive restart; a corrupt store degrades to empty

phases.title: The trigger
phases.outcome: assigned tag acts with the app closed; anything else does nothing. Security-critical

phases.title: Management UI
phases.outcome: create from last scan, edit, delete, test now

phases.title: Device verification
phases.outcome: AC1-AC8 evidenced on hardware, docs updated

notable_decisions: kotlinx.serialization added for persistence, unlike the hand-encoded export path: the exporter only writes, persistence must also READ, and hand-writing a JSON parser is where silent corruption lives. @Serializable DTOs live in data/ so domain/ stays annotation-free
Intent construction sits behind a pure IntentSpec seam so the risky mapping is unit-tested while the thin Android adapter is device-verified, consistent with ADR 0001
AC6 (exported activity abuse) is tested via a pure shouldAct predicate rather than an instrumented test, since no androidTest source set exists
known_tradeoffs: less capable than MacroDroid by design: no conditions, scheduling or HTTP
will collide with MacroDroid if both are configured - Android may show a chooser per tap; README must warn
a silent no-op on an unmapped tag can read as a broken app until the behaviour is known

parallel_execution.note: slices share types and are too small to fan out
